scope: Mechanism, observable, controls and finite domain; no adjudication of mind, life, consciousness or general intelligence

artifacts.artifact_gate: Each of24 measured cases asserts the qualification, interpreter identity, wheel and native hashes, plus byte equality of every installed .py/.pyi member against the qualified wheel before executing its handler
artifacts.audit_limit: Source and recorded product gate inspected; not an OS-wide syscall audit

coverage.counting: One observer-cut record contains an acquired prefix and two diagnostic forks. Dialogue cases reuse the composition mechanism. Deterministic continuations and ticks are not independent statistical replicates.
coverage.inputs: Synthetic explicitly prepared DEE fields/events, not measured machinery, sensors or thermodynamic experiments outside the computer

mechanisms.mechanism: Two normal carriers evolve under frozen v27 along declared free routes in N34
mechanisms.operational_reading: Transport and arrival remain measurable with these clocks and translated geometry
mechanisms.external_work: The5/9 forecast is calculated from declared geometry and saved before evolution by the INSTRUMENTO
not_established: An organization learned a period or forecast

mechanisms.mechanism: Two equal-inventory preparations differ in native incoming direction; the directional reducer produces distinct joint records
mechanisms.operational_reading: Equal input load inventory does not determine the complete output; direction and meeting geometry matter
mechanisms.label_caution: first_current_contact_record means first active target record in the4..6 window. no_contact contains a lone arriving carrier, not an absence or a verified joint collision.

temperature_attempt.interpretation: Finite computational exchange/organizational observations; no numerical temperature estimate was produced

mechanisms.observer_limit: direction_counts tracks only the two original direction bins: both can become0 while active_count remains1 because a new joint direction exists

mechanisms.mechanism: Previously measured native-contact direction codes18/24 are externally replayed as declared teacher inputs to two fresh NativeAssociationSession routes; later responses come from evolving acquired mobile relations
mechanisms.matched_control: Unpaired has the same four admitted cue/teacher inputs, with teacher requests at1 rather than0; this is not an entry-rejection control
mechanisms.operational_reading: Physical pairing/history affects later common queries; the same continuing material is used and changed by sequential probes
mechanisms.external_coupling: Native contact Runtime -> fixed external direction codec -> another native Runtime. This is not same-world native transfer of the contact history.
mechanisms.oracle_audit: q+5+teacher is calculated only in evaluation_only after native evolution; it is never passed to a world, channel or decoder. Later sequential responses are not forced to equal the first-query formula.
mechanisms.domain: Two fixed N34 routes, three consuming queries through21; bounded additive family, not arbitrary semantics or unlimited retained associations

mechanisms.mechanism: After acquisition, the investigator removes RAW at one actual mobile carrier site in a complete diagnostic fork, preserving its clock; a separate intact fork receives the same common query
mechanisms.operational_reading: The removed historical carrier contributes selectively to q0 under this panel; the q1 response survives that intervention
limits: This is external diagnosis, not native introspection or self-modification
It does not establish a universal carrier identity or independence at every later horizon

mechanisms.mechanism: In one N47 Research Runtime, two environmental currents meet, the product meets an organization cue, and the resulting mobile relation meets two common probes
mechanisms.operational_reading: A world-produced interaction changes a mobile relation and later native responses without an inter-Runtime teacher codec. Both the contact route and cue encounter matter in the frozen panel.
mechanisms.what_is_external: Preparation, fixed probe requests, passive observations and explicit save/load; no adaptive postT0 event installation
limits: Finite moving relation, not a renewable basal body
Prepared physical opportunities, not autonomous discovery of arbitrary tasks
Not a demonstrated closed loop where the organization's action generates the earlier environmental contact
Two uses and one translated/query variant, not unlimited learning or capacity

mechanisms.mechanism: Two initially unacquired relations coexist in a native N127 cascade, receive actual cue/teacher experiences, and transform a common query along physical routes
mechanisms.operational_reading: The acquired second relation contributes27 in this finite common-query protocol, while the first-stage response remains38 in the omission contrast
limits: A known additive physical composition, not a new abstraction hierarchy
No host output callback between stages
The two relations are acquired inside the already coexisting world, not transplanted learned snapshots

mechanisms.operational_reading: A fixed coordinate/window can miss a moving functional response; null there does not establish forgotten or destroyed history
limits: The native query protocol supplies declared moving targets, not a universal certified genealogy tracker
A historical captured response is an observer record, not a new live answer
Sequential physical probes have backaction and are not passive observations

mechanisms.mechanism: A finite Spanish parser and external aliases request native operations; the fixed renderer exposes their current measurements
mechanisms.operational_reading: A saved acquired native composition answers an unused numerical query after restoration; changing aliases changes presentation but not physical evolution
limits: Names and Spanish grammar are external meanings, not DEE-acquired arbitrary word associations
The ENTE attribution identifies the physical response's origin, not linguistic understanding or consciousness
The generic explanation is documental, not an experimentally demonstrated introspective report
The reserved UI case is one supplemental realization, not a second independent capability

supplemental_signal_prediction.mechanism: Two current local N35-world observations are externally encoded as physical A/B experiences in an initially H0 N47 body. The acquired relative memory produces a current physical direction at37. That emission is stored before either world reaches its target67; the truth is the actual local N35 detector at67.

controls.omitted_experience: Same actual signal-world history as present_then_absent, but no body experience: no singleton physical forecast
controls.withheld_future_route: A semantic4 zero-load obstacle8 sites ahead is installed beforeT0. Local samples32/33 and body emission37 are byte/field-identical to intact, but actual detector67 differs. The body receives no obstacle flag.
controls.reserved_world_preparations: Detector(18,16,20), direction(0,-1,0), current-present/current-absent; both frozen before runs, no adjustment
controls.restore_pending37: Both body and signal world restored with pending unevaluated forecast; RAW/clocks, body readout, current detector and predictions equal direct continuation67

supplemental_signal_prediction.operational_reading: The finite acquired history is used to emit an antecedent physical prediction that matches the later periodic detector in four intact preparations, including two translated/reoriented worlds. Omitting experiences removes the singleton distinction. The withheld route change gives a recorded forecast error instead of an unseen-future response.
limits: The toroidal period35 and target horizon are prepared context, not a learned temporal-period estimate
Absence at the two sensor samples is classified by an explicit external local observer, not by a native DEE absence detector
Two Runtimes remain distinct; this does not establish a native one-world sensing-body loop
The internal CognitiveSession barrier evaluator belongs to a different environment: its raw evaluations are retained as NO_APLICA_OTRO_ENTORNO and do not supply training, truth, or score
The carrier-world path supports a finite periodic signal forecast under declared context, not arbitrary future prediction or inaccessible-obstacle anticipation
Six deterministic fresh preparations and one technical continuation are not independent statistical samples of a population

remaining_uncertainties: Only finite horizons and the frozen queries/positions/clocks were measured; do not infer arbitrary-environment robustness
Online contact acquisition supports one finite mobile relation, not complete persistent basal identity or renewal
Direction-code replay and same-world online acquisition are distinct modalities and representations
The experiment supplies no thermodynamic temperature, general scalar-energy correspondence, equilibrium or FDT result
No learned periodic signal anticipation was measured by the original three transport cases; their predictor is explicitly an external geometry baseline
No arbitrary learned Spanish dictionary or optimal information-seeking policy follows from these cases
The parent report must distinguish newly executed24 case records from reused BlockI technical evidence and earlier CPC3 measurements

interpretive_planes.computational_facts: Recorded states, clocks, directions, admission, restore equality, physical outputs and hashes above
interpretive_planes.DEE_mechanisms: Frozen-v27 transport, native meetings/reducer, acquired moving relations, physical query backaction and native cascades
interpretive_planes.operational_inferences: History-dependent common-query behavior, selective historical-carrier contribution and observer-dependent accessibility within the measured panel
interpretive_planes.hypotheses_not_adjudicated: More general persistence, unlimited reuse, thermodynamics, linguistic understanding, biological correspondence or general cognition
